summary: Starting Wave 1: Deploy foundational Telltail 0.3.0 Go codebase, core packages, and CLI to replace sacrificial seed.
planner_memory: Accepted base f4b92cb on telltail-canonical-seed contains sacrificial clamp program. Goal: canonical Telltail 0.3.0 Go CLI satisfying all ACs. Wave 1 schedules foundational implementation of pkg/{trajectory,scenario,detector,profiler,dossier,local,batch,mirror} and cmd/telltail, establishing hash-chained JSONL, deterministic detectors, profiler, dossier, local runner, mirror challenge, and GCP batch spec/harness with unit and cross-platform verification.
